units.source_text: 那是浪明的，充满寂光①，从下方，从内倒把这个地上的世界完全吞噬，

en.t: It was luminous and overflowing with serene light, and from below, from within, it completely swallowed up this earthly world,

units.source_text: 金阁就像黑油油的锈透了的巨大的纯金钱，沉落在其中……

en.t: and the Golden Pavilion, like a huge solid gold coin black with oily gleam and eaten through with rust, sank down into it...
